ranking_basis: Epistemic leverage and current likelihood of obtaining transcription-bearing source bytes with independently auditable editorial provenance; not expected linguistic outcome.

routes.source: Del Freo & Zurbach, Recueil des inscriptions en linéaire A. Supplément 1
reason: Current 2024/2025 edition with explicit continuation of the GORILA/Recueil editorial methodology.
Two current official coauthor contact routes are known.

An institutional EFA Academia document object with a free-PDF UI route and transcription-bearing table-of-contents preview is publicly visible, although JANUS transport has not acquired the PDF bytes.
preferred_action_order: Retry lawful public EFA/Academia PDF byte acquisition without login circumvention or scraping bypass.
Use formal CNR IRIS Request a copy route if public bytes remain unavailable.
If needed, send one concise research request to a coauthor, optionally copying the other, avoiding duplicate repeated outreach.

routes.source: Raison & Pope, Corpus transnuméré du linéaire A, 2nd ed.
reason: Independent scholarly review describes re-examination of texts against photographs/new facsimiles and corrected/new readings, making it a strong alternate-editorial candidate.
Current publisher catalogue and publisher contact route are available.
No open byte-bearing digital copy has yet been verified.
preferred_action_order: If no open bytes appear, ask Peeters for research access, archival electronic copy, legacy production files, or an authorized preservation-copy route.

routes.source: Consani & Negri, Testi minoici trascritti, con interpretazione e glossario
reason: Large transcription-bearing monograph with a living author/institution route.
IULM public research record confirms the work but currently has no associated files.
The degree of transcription independence from GORILA/other existing corpora is currently less well established than for CTLA and must remain unresolved until provenance review.
preferred_action_order: If no open bytes appear, contact Mario Negri for a research copy, surviving production source, or a hypothesis-independent transcription-bearing sample.

byte_arrival_protocol: Immediately preserve original bytes without opening or conversion.
Apply frozen R3B-0 acquisition receipt contract and establish edition/access/provenance identity.
Do not search known candidate strings or transcription differences before the scientific-content-excluded identity inventory and R3B-1 partition are frozen.
Assign L1/L2/L3 only after provenance evidence; do not infer independence from different publication format.
